messages:
irene: Quick note from tonight's onboarding: onboarded ember-embed-6B int4 on the small-queries holdout and saw R@1 drop ~10ppt vs fp16. R@10 roughly stable.

sam: can you paste the eval command and a tiny table?

irene: ran: `python eval.py --model ember-6B --quant int4 --holdout small_queries_v2 --k 1,10 --norm l2`
irene: fp16 (5k q) R@1 0.62 R@10 0.81; int4 R@1 0.52 R@10 0.80

leo: similar pattern we've seen. check per-channel vs per-tensor quant and whitening/centering. small queries are sensitive to tiny cosine shifts.
irene: used backend `fastq`, per_channel=false.
sam: try `--per_channel true` and `--apply_whitening true`. also run a slice for queries length <6.
irene: launching two quick runs.
eval-bot: job queued eval-4301230000-1 (per_channel true) ETA ~5m. job queued eval-4301230000-2 (per_channel true + whitening) ETA ~7m.
eval-bot: eval-4301230000-1 done: R@1 0.58 R@10 0.80. eval-4301230000-2 done: R@1 0.61 R@10 0.81.

leo: per-channel + whitening basically recovers. sounds like change infra default for ember family.
irene: i'll draft a 1-slide QC with cosine delta histograms and per-length R@1. plan: propose per_channel=true canary at 10% on dedicated.

ops-bot: canary scheduled 2026-04-03 09:00 UTC on rdw-ded-2, route 10% to ember-6B int4-perchannel.
sam: i'll run 3-seed stability checks and add checks for multi-turn prompts.
irene: thanks, assigning sam->multi-seed, leo->infra RFC, me->QC slide and metrics dashboard. will update thread after canary.
